data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Centralized redundancy is a 'Fragility Trap' where the tools used to ensure reliability (standardized monitoring, unified deployment) actually maximize the potential for catastrophic correlated failure.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The centralized entity implements 'Synthetic Diversity' (intentionally running different versions/configs) that exceeds the organic diversity of the decentralized network.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"The primary failure mode is an external dependency that ignores internal implementation diversity.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The 'Standardization Trap' mechanism: by removing 'inefficient' variance to achieve high SLAs, the central operator eliminates the structural dampers that prevent failure propagation.
